svg.title: XIAO to Sony interface: all seven internal jumpers
svg.desc: Match the same numbered circles on the XIAO breakout and the Sony board. The XIAO is viewed from the component side with USB-C up. The Sony interface is viewed from underneath with row 1 up. The middle lists every connection by pad.
svg.text: Seven removable jumpers inside the project box. Match the numbered circles on both boards.
J and B are the access headers.
Circle numbers identify jumpers. J1 labels identify contacts.
B4 is SCK on the breakout and ground on the Sony board.
Underside · flipped left to right · row 1 up
Open rings: B9 spare ground and J2 (Sony cable).
Power off before wiring. Check continuity by pad name at both ends.
USB 5 V is breakout B9 → Sony I1. The knob’s 3.3 V comes from breakout A7.
